scenes.setting: Over Sirius's corpse behind the library: Klein reads the letters to 'Mr. Z' — the Antigonus family held the Seer pathway — and decides on a mediumship ritual
scenes.text_anchor: One pocket, two pockets, three pockets

scenes.setting: The shattered oriel window: Klein sends a librarian for police backup, has the crowd cordon the scene, and returns to the corpse to prepare the ritual
scenes.text_anchor: He raised his head, turned around, and cast his gaze toward the spot where the window had shattered.
